title: To Defer or Not to Defer? Online Learning with LLMs and Congested Experts
abstract: arXiv:2610.15128v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Modern AI systems increasingly combine large language models (LLMs) with human experts, using the LLM to handle routine queries while deferring uncertain cases for expert review. When expert capacity is limited, however, deferral decisions must account not only for the reliability of the LLM but also for congestion in the expert queue. We formulate this as an online sequential decision-making problem in which, for each query, the system observes the confidence signal of the LLM's answer and must decide whether to output the answer or defer the query to a capacity-constrained expert. The reliability of the confidence signal is initially unknown and must be learned from expert feedback, which is both selectively observed (only deferred queries are labeled) and delayed by queuing. We propose \texttt{KL-PBD}, a learning algorithm that uses Kullback--Leibler lower confidence bounds on the unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral dec

translated_title: 延迟还是不延迟？基于大语言模型与拥塞专家的在线学习
translated_abstract: 现代AI系统越来越多地将大语言模型（LLM）与人类专家相结合，利用LLM处理常规查询，同时将不确定的情况转交给专家审核。然而，当专家容量有限时，延迟决策不仅需要考虑LLM的可靠性，还需要考虑专家队列中的拥塞情况。我们将该问题形式化为一个在线序贯决策问题：对于每个查询，系统观察LLM答案的置信度信号，并必须决定是输出该答案，还是将查询转交给容量受限的专家。置信度信号的可靠性起初是未知的，必须从专家反馈中学习，而这种反馈既是选择性观测的（只有被延迟的查询才会被标注），又因排队而存在延迟。我们提出了KL-PBD，一种学习算法，它利用未知可靠性参数的Kullback-Leibler下置信界来指导延迟决策。
tldr: 该论文提出了KL-PBD算法，利用KL下置信界在线学习LLM置信度信号的未知可靠性，在专家容量受限、专家反馈仅有选择性观测且被排队延迟的情况下，指导是否将查询转交给专家的延迟决策。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes KL-PBD, an online learning algorithm that uses KL-based lower confidence bounds on unknown reliability parameters to guide deferral decisions when LLMs are paired with capacity-constrained experts, where reliability must be learned from selectively observed and queuing-delayed expert feedback.
